name: star-forge
description: A Codex-native software factory: plan, build with sub-agents, load-bearing review, and a completion predicate computed from git facts.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build with sub-agents, review, and prove completion from git facts — the Forge Loop.
interface.longDescription: Star Forge is a Codex-native software factory built on the Forge Loop: plan (Blueprint with acceptance criteria, one approval) -> build (sub-agent builders, coordinator-recorded verify and browser-run evidence) -> review (reviewer agents write findings that feed a fix queue the completion gate consumes) -> done (a predicate computed from git tree state, never a recorded claim). Post-completion edits automatically reopen the project as an amendment. Hooks observe and re-anchor across compaction; they never block. Lessons compound across projects via a global learnings store.
defaultPrompt: $forge build this idea end to end
$forge-review run the review wave and prove completion
